en.body:
After the enthusiasm of the first series of the “Energy Drinks” events in August 2023 in Bern, which gathered around half of the audience coming outside of SWEET EDGE, we will reiterate the experience! These events aim at gathering the public around a drink while listening to several presentations per night on hot energy topics for Switzerland. To make it livelier, games with the public are organized after each presentation and there will be prices to win!

2 evenings, 2 topics:  
⚡️22 May 2024: 100% renewables in Switzerland? Wishful thinking or a realistic option?  
🗻23 May 2024: Hype or hope? What is the use of alpine photovoltaics in Switzerland?

Open to all. Games. Talks. Quizzes. Prizes to win! 🎉  
👀 What? 4 presentations per night on hot energy topics!  
🕕 When? 22 & 23 May 2024, from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m.  
🍻 Where? At “[The Alehouse](https://www.alehouse.ch/)”, Zurich  
💬 Language? In German  
👋 No registration required. Free of charge!

[\-> Final Programme here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MU7B39FPkUzjVx25pzZKyNTgisA3_Stc/view?usp=sharing)
